intro: Charleston's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $125/month, down 3.9% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Charleston metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $117, down 10.3% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $143. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $42 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$50.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $73 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$83. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $125, down 3.9% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Charleston metro non-climate asking rent $117, down 10.3% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Charleston alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$143.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $161 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$214.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $203 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$269.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Cherokee Hall - Sylvan Shores (~$132), Grimball - Signal Point (~$138), Woodland Shores - Pecan Grove (~$143) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Air Harbor - Geddes Hall (~$189) is among the highest.
Charleston has about 35 facilities and 6.5 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 230,839 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026 (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
